messages:
Renee P: Heads-up - HELIXBIO (acct: HELIX-12) invoice INV-12011 for $23,750 is 41 days overdue. AP says a check was mailed but then they issued a stop-pay.
Omar V: Stop-pay? Any reason?
Renee P: AP cited a withholding/tax treatment question for payment to our US entity vs their Luxembourg subsidiary. They put a stop-pay until tax team reviews.
BillingBot: Autopay not enabled for INV-12011. Payment link: https://pay.redwood.ai/inv/INV-12011
Omar V: Can they pay via wire instead while they sort tax? That avoids the stop-pay risk. Also need remittance address and EIN for their tax team.
Renee P: I sent our W-9 and wire instructions. AP replied they require a withholding certificate from us if payment flows to US entity. They asked for a vendor form (W-8/W-9 confirmation) and a copy of our tax residency.
Sam R (Legal): We are US tax resident; W-9 is fine. No withholding certificate necessary for payment to US entity. But we should avoid too much tax advice in Slack. Attach W-9 and reference accounts team. If they insist on holding funds, propose partial payment.
CS - Mei: Product impact: they flagged the account for throttling if payment not posted in 7 days. They'd rather not suspend but need a firm timeline.
Renee P: Proposed short plan in email: 
```
- Release 70% by wire within 5 business days to avoid throttling
- Hold remaining 30% pending tax confirmation (max 30 days)
- No service suspension while partial posted
- Provide W-9 and wire instructions to AP
```
Omar V: I like that. @Sam R (Legal) ok to accept 70/30 split with hold language? Need to ensure hold doesn't waive late fees or change terms permanently.
Sam R (Legal): Acceptable as a one-time arrangement. Document signed email acceptance. No waiver of late fees beyond the documented hold unless CFO signs off. If they convert to check after stop-pay, ensure we don't accept refunded check if stop-pay was customer-initiated.
BillingBot: Draft invoice INV-12011-ADJ created for split payment arrangement. Payment link for 70%: https://pay.redwood.ai/inv/INV-12011/partial
Renee P: Sent proposal to AP and cc'd accounts-payable@helixbio.eu and their tax counsel. Requested wire confirmation and signed acceptance of split.
Collections Partner: Pls pause collections outreach while we evaluate the partial payment proposal. Will resume if no payment by 1743800001.
Helix AP (external): "We can wire 70% (EUR equivalent) but need confirmation of banking details and beneficiary name match. Tax counsel insists on documentation before releasing remainder."
Omar V: Confirmed bank name and beneficiary match our finance ops. Asked them to send SWIFT quote for fees and net amount. Also warned that currency conversion could cause small remainder differences.
BillingBot: Wire received: $16,625 (txn: WIRE-889900). Remaining balance: $7,125.
CS - Mei: Received wire; restored full API throughput. Updating churn flag off.
Renee P: Posted ledger entry. Updating invoice status -> "Partial Hold - Tax Review". Noted tax docs attached.
Sam R (Legal): Ensure signed acceptance email is saved. Also request that any refunded check or stop-pay that results in chargeback triggers immediate collections.
Helix AP (external): "Tax counsel sent confirmation that no withholding required; remainder will be released within 10 business days. We'll send confirmation once processed."
Omar V: Good. Set reminder to follow-up day-9 and day-14. Also note FX variance tolerance of $50 to be absorbed by us or adjust? Thoughts?
Renee P: We'll absorb up to $50 on this one. Anything larger we will invoice as minor FX adjustment. Documented in the ack.
Collections Partner: Noted. Will remain on hold. Escalate to collections at 1743800001 if no remainder posted.
BillingBot: Final payment of $7,125 posted (txn: WIRE-889901). Invoice INV-12011 now paid in full.
Renee P: Received final payment and tax confirmation. Closing out. Adding note: keep AP contact helix.ap@helixbio.eu and tax counsel looped for future invoices to avoid repeats.
Omar V: Great. Please add 30-day watch for any chargebacks and flag if stop-pay reappears.
CS - Mei: All set on our side; renewal team notified. Thanks. :tada:
